name: Nullform AR Visor MK-3 Ghost
description:
A wraparound AR visor in matte charcoal polymer with a single-piece curved lens that shifts between full transparency and deep-tint privacy mode in under 200ms. The temple arms are thickened to house dual micro-processors and a short-range mesh antenna. A slim copper contact rail along the inner brow interfaces directly with compatible BCI hardware for hands-free overlay control.

The lens surface carries a faint iridescent treatment visible only at oblique angles — a signature Nullform aesthetic detail. Popular with field operatives and off-books analysts who need AR overlay without broadcasting that they're running it.
functionality: Full AR overlay display; BCI-direct interface for hands-free control; 200ms transparency-to-tint switching; short-range mesh antenna for local data pulls; auto-brightness adjustment; 14-hour charge cycle via inductive temple pad.
what_it_says: You're always reading more information than anyone in the room realizes.
story_hooks: A batch of MK-3 units contains a firmware backdoor that streams overlay data to an unknown third-party server.
A fixer is selling a MK-3 with archived AR recordings of a closed Spire board meeting embedded in corrupted cache memory.
Nullform's lead engineer has gone missing; the last known location pings from a MK-3 unit that was supposed to be decommissioned.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, minimalist wraparound visor that dominates the upper face with a seamless curved lens. The design reads as deliberately understated—purposefully anonymous rather than flashy. Worn low on the bridge, it frames the eyes with architectural precision, creating an impassive, augmented appearance that suggests enhanced perception rather than visual aggression.
physical_description.fit: Snug but not clamping; the wraparound geometry distributes weight across temple and nose bridge. The thickened arms grip the sides of the head with engineered precision, leaving no gaps. Adjustable friction-fit contact points allow micro-positioning without visible fasteners.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade matte charcoal polymer composite with optical-grade curved lens in anti-reflective smart-glass capable of dynamic tinting
physical_description.texture: Smooth, slightly grippy matte finish on the polymer frame; the lens is glass-smooth with a faint warm-copper iridescence visible only when light hits at oblique angles. Temple arms have subtle knurled sections for secure grip and thermal dissipation
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte charcoal-black polymer frame with a clear-to-dark-smoke gradient lens. Copper contact rail glints subtly along the inner brow. Faint rainbow iridescence shifts across lens surface at certain angles—a deliberate Nullform signature
physical_description.closures: Friction-fit temple arms with micro-adjustment points; no buckles or snaps—designed for quick removal without fumbling
distinctive_features: Single-piece curved lens with adaptive tint technology (transparent to privacy-dark in <200ms)
Dual micro-processor housings integrated into thickened temple arms
Short-range mesh antenna embedded in left temple
Copper BCI contact rail along inner brow for direct neural-interface compatibility
Iridescent coating visible only at oblique angles—signature Nullform aesthetic
No visible branding—deliberately unmarked for operational discretion
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 borderline; independent tech, not corpo-grade but clearly well-engineered. Signals technical sophistication and discretionary budget without conspicuous wealth
physical_description.cultural_context: Field operative, off-books analyst, covert information broker, independent security contractor. Worn by people who need augmented vision but cannot afford—or do not want—obvious corpo AR rigs. Signals competence, privacy consciousness, and potential legal ambiguity
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to lightly worn; kept meticulously clean to maintain optical clarity. Minor micro-scratches on lens from field use, but never patched or visibly damaged—this is a tool that must function flawlessly
